newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS rates Poco Petroleums' debt.
newsitem.headline: DBRS rates Poco Petroleums' debt.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Monday it assigned an R-1 (low) rating with a stable trend to Poco Petroleums Ltd's commercial paper.
DBRS said the rating reflected the successful completion of the first phase of a business plan implemented by senior management in 1993.
The plan was designed to refocus and shift exploration, development and acquisition activities to areas offering somewhat higher risk, larger and longer life opportunities.

"This program has resulted in a significant rise in reserves and production, at reasonable per-unit reserve replacement cost. Also, operating and administrative costs have been well controlled," DBRS said. ((Jeffrey Jones, Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
